title: War rules: shuffle, deal, flip, compare, collect
requirements: Start from one 52-card deck and deal alternately, never by simply assigning the first 26 cards to one player in a code-specific view.
Keep Player 1 left, Player 2 right, pot center; counters sum to 52 after every transfer.
Teach Ace high, rank-only comparison, winning cards appended to the bottom, and the normal three-down/one-up war.
Use fixtures/war_storyboard.json for illustrative states; these are teaching examples, not an alleged captured game.
Do not animate the disputed insufficient-cards ending until R05 is resolved; an ordinary adequately stocked war is safe.

Include the stated victory condition: win all 52 cards. Show it as a rule caption in the closing hold, not as a fabricated completion of the miniature example. The insufficient-cards rule remains scoped to R05.
beats: 0–4 s: full deck, shuffle abstraction, 52 label.
4–10 s: alternating deal ends at 26 / 26 / pot 0.
10–16 s: A♠ beats K♥; pot 2 travels to Player 1 bottom; counters become 27 / 25.
16–24 s: reset visibly to the independent single-war fixture and show the tie, six burns, and deciding pair.
24–28 s: collect the ten-card pot and hold the rank-only rule.
checks: Every visible card has a unique identity within its scene.
Deal cutdown independently opens and closes on readable states.
No strategic choices, suit trumping, or additional randomness during play are implied.
Normal round has 2 cards, ordinary war has 10, and awarded cards enter the queue bottom.
